question: V slávnom dokumentárnom seriáli The Jinx sa podozrivý milionár Robert Durst nechtiac priznal k vraždám, lebo zabudol, že má na sebe zapnutý mikrofón. Kam si vtedy odbehol?
source_excerpt: Durst's microphone was still on when he went into a bathroom, and HBO staffers were packing their equipment at the time

extra.why_interesting: People expect a confession to come out of a tense interview or interrogation. The real one came from a forgotten clip-on microphone in the most ordinary place there is, so a player can work out the answer from the footholds and still be surprised by it.
extra.verification_notes: Durst's hot-mic 'killed them all' remark was recorded while he was in a bathroom, per the ABA Journal summary of the NYT report (https://www.abajournal.com/news/article/real_estate_heir_is_arrested_before_his_killed_them_all_comment_airs_on_doc).

explanation: Na záchode si zamrmlal „Zabil som ich všetkých, samozrejme“ a tvorcovia tie slová objavili až pri spracúvaní zvuku. Dursta zatkli tesne pred odvysielaním poslednej časti.

question: V kauze vraždy Jána Kuciaka, o ktorej vznikol aj dokument The Killing of a Journalist, sa na verejnosť dostali tisíce Kočnerových správ z jednej šifrovanej aplikácie. Ako sa volá?
source_excerpt: Kuciak trial: Threema messages accepted as evidence

extra.why_interesting: Players assume an 'ultra-secure' encrypted app keeps secrets safe. In fact, this app became a byword for exposed secrets in Slovakia. Most Slovak adults heard the name over and over in the news, so the answer surfaces with a satisfying 'of course!'
extra.verification_notes: Kočner's chats in the Kuciak case came from the encrypted app Threema, confirmed by STVR reporting on the trial (https://enrsi.stvr.sk/articles/news/215473/kuciak-trial-threema-messages-accepted-as-evidence).

explanation: Švajčiarska Threema sa propaguje ako mimoriadne bezpečná, no Kočnerove rozhovory z nej sa vďaka zaisteným telefónom dostali k vyšetrovateľom. Jej názov sa tak na Slovensku stal synonymom odhalených tajomstiev.
